mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_ordered_calculation_state (object_id, field_id, signature, state, total_rows, creator, updater) VALUES (#{row.objectId}, #{row.fieldId}, #{row.signature}, #{row.state}, #{row.totalRows}, #{row.creator}, #{row.updater})
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_ordered_calculation_state SET state = #{row.state}, cursor_json = CAST(#{row.cursorJson} AS jsonb), total_rows = #{row.totalRows}, updated_rows = #{row.updatedRows}, completed_groups = #{row.completedGroups}, error_message = #{row.errorMessage}, lock_version = lock_version + 1, updater = #{row.updater}, update_time = clock_timestamp() WHERE object_id = #{row.objectId} AND field_id = #{row.fieldId} AND signature = #{row.signature} AND lock_version = #{revision} AND deleted = 0
